summary: Iteration 59 — Pros&Cons AI assess + XLS template export/import (Phase C) tested end-to-end on the BACKEND. All 9 pytest cases pass (9/9 = 100%): AI assess (400 on missing actual, 200 returns pct/cell_value/source and persists, 404 on bad factor), Pros&Cons XLS export (returns valid xlsx with attachment header), Pros&Cons XLS round-trip (template seeded with assessment_pct=75 + actual='9500' on a SUB-factor, re-uploaded unchanged → import applied≥1, sub-factor cell unchanged), Pros&Cons import garbage rejected (400), My Dezider XLS export (returns valid xlsx), My Dezider XLS round-trip (main + sub factor assessments survive export→reupload, worth_percentage recomputed >0), My Dezider import garbage rejected (400). Frontend smoke: landing page loads cleanly on mobile viewport 390x844, no console errors (only harmless shadow*/resizeMode deprecation warnings). All four required testIDs confirmed in source: pc-xls-download + pc-xls-import (pros-cons-wizard.tsx:1647,1651), md-xls-download + md-xls-import (Step7.tsx:443,447). LmhAiButtons component exists with L/M/H chips + sparkles AI button (pros-cons-wizard.tsx:3003), but the L/M/H/AI sub-controls have NO testIDs — minor and the same kind of gap flagged in iter58 for the weight UI.

minor.issue: `source` field in the response is set to 'ai' whenever EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is present, even when the LLM call ACTUALLY failed and the numeric-ratio fallback produced the percentage. During this run the backend logs showed `AI assess fallback: ... Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.4254, Max budget: 0.4` yet the API still returned source='ai'. Recommend tracking whether the LLM branch succeeded and reporting source='ratio' on fallback so the frontend can show an accurate label. Reference: routes/pros_cons.py:944.

ui_bugs.issue: L/M/H chips and the AI (sparkles) button render correctly but have NO testIDs. Cannot be reliably driven by Playwright for L/M/H/AI flow regression. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/pros-cons-wizard.tsx:3003-3035
The Custom % numeric input adjacent to the L/M/H/AI chips has no obvious dedicated testID. Recommend pc-custom-pct-{oid}-{fid} for parity with My Dezider.

action_items: Add testIDs to LmhAiButtons (and the paired Custom % input) so future agents can deep-test the L/M/H + AI flow in browser. Suggested: testID={`pc-lmh-${k}-${oid}-${fid}`} on each chip, testID={`pc-ai-${oid}-${fid}`} on AI button, testID={`pc-custom-pct-${oid}-${fid}`} on the percent input. Same in Step7.tsx for My Dezider parity.
Optional: also add testIDs to the L/M/H equivalents in My Dezider Step7.tsx if not yet present.

Frontend deep-flow test (download triggers a real file, file picker upload round-trip) was deliberately NOT performed — per the agent-to-agent note this is outside Playwright's reach for the web preview. Main agent can self-verify by clicking 'Download template' in browser and re-uploading via 'Import filled'.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/pros-cons/{id}/factors/{fid}/ai-assess correctly enforces presence of Actual via 400 with descriptive detail (routes/pros_cons.py:880-883), and falls back to numeric-ratio when LLM unavailable. Verified by test_ai_assess_requires_actual.

core/assessment_xlsx.py uses a HIDDEN row-1 machine header (factor_id col + per-option actual:/pct: tokens) — robust to column reorder. Round-trip verified twice (Pros&Cons sub-factor + My Dezider main+sub). Implementation is clean and shared correctly between the two flows.

routes/decisions.py:184-216 properly upserts assessments by (option, factor), preserving prior fields and only mutating unit_value / percentage when present in the import row. Worth recomputation uses top-level factors only — sub-factor refinement is deferred to the client (documented in code).
routes/pros_cons.py:933-944 persists assessment_pct + actual_value + cell_value via $set on nested fields (concurrency-safe), consistent with the same pattern used for PUT /assessments. Good.
Both XLS endpoints return correct Content-Disposition (attachment; filename=...) with sanitized titles (max 40 chars, alnum + space/-/_). Solid.

success_rate.frontend: Smoke only — landing loads, no errors. Deep XLS+AI button flow not exercised in browser (Playwright cannot drive file download/picker). testIDs for the wizard top-bar XLS buttons (pc-xls-* / md-xls-*) confirmed present in source.
